llm.note: PTKP from 2013 is computed as Rp24.300.000 for self plus Rp2.025.000 per addition, where the marriage addition (huruf b) and the dependent additions (huruf d, max 3) share the same amount and are counted per status in one lookup table; the new rule supersedes REG.PTKP.AMOUNT by lex posterior from 1 January 2013. The addition for a wife whose income is combined (huruf c) is not modelled as it does not apply to employee withholding statuses.
